scope: T18a local ASR preflight for Japanese-led audio with a short English project name. Synthetic smoke sample, not a production release acceptance.
environment: macOS arm64, macOS say at default rate, ffmpeg mono PCM16 16000 Hz. Insert 8000 zero samples after each utterance.

samples.text: 担当は田中さんです。予算は三百五十万円です。
次の会議は十二月十九日の午後二時です。佐藤さんが参加します。

results.finding: Preserved Japanese names, amounts, date and time in two segments. Omitted the English project name in both modes.
The VAD path also omitted the English project name.
Preserved the project name in katakana and Japanese facts. The aligner fell back to a single chunk spanning 0 to 13.2166875 seconds in both modes.

decision: Keep Japanese disabled in T18b and T18c. The tested configurations did not provide both coverage and segment-level audio location. The ASR gate failed before downstream translation and real-time acceptance.
